Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security & Privacy items from today's discovery call

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security & privacy items we covered during the demo: 

1) SOC 2
- You asked about our SOC 2 Type II status. Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q1 2025 and we can share the latest report under NDA.

2) GDPR / HIPAA applicability
- You mentioned potential EU customers and a need to understand GDPR data residency and controller/processor roles. Also flagged HIPAA as a possible requirement for one of your business lines.

3) Vendor security questionnaire
- Happy to start the vendor security questionnaire. If you can share a contact (security@acmecorp.com or a person), I will route our security team to complete it. We usually return questionnaires within 3–5 business days depending on scope.

4) Product telemetry & cookies (console + docs sites)
- You asked where telemetry is sent (console backend, analytics, error reporting), what cookies/third-party scripts are present on our customer console and docs, and retention windows. Dev will prepare a concise list of telemetry endpoints, cookie classifications, and retention policies.

Next steps
- I'll send our Redwood Security Overview and the vendor questionnaire template for you to forward to your security team.
- Dev (cc'd) will produce a 1–2 page Telemetry & Cookies FAQ for the console/docs.
- Rishi (cc'd) will pull the SOC 2 evidence we can share and confirm HIPAA posture.

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync on Thu 6/18 to review questionnaire answers and any gaps. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (summary + controls)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

I'm attaching the vendor_security_qs.xlsx template (pre-fill as much as you can) — we'll send the draft back to them and schedule the Thu 10:00am PT slot.

If either of you can't take full ownership, let me know and I'll escalate.

Thanks,
Marissa
